verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show user-configurable automations that run on their own in the background. Build mode is autonomous only while carrying out a task the user just requested, which is a one-off action rather than a recurring trigger or schedule. Edge functions are developer building blocks, and scheduled Deep scans are a narrow enterprise security feature rather than general automations, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
